parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: HA
Aquifer depth: 0.12 m – 9.67 m (Layer 2, ρ ≈ 15.97 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target the shallow sandy/clayey-sand horizon between approximately 0.12 m and 9.67 m depth as the primary water-bearing zone; screen the borehole across this interval and case off the deeper highly resistive layers (ρ > 4500 Ω·m) below 9.67 m, which likely represent compact/dry formations with limited groundwater potential.
